items.en: HUR: Russia keeps missile stocks steady at up to 700 ballistic and several thousand cruise missiles, produces 200+ missiles a month, and has ordered over 100,000 Geran-type drones and decoys for 2026

items.sEn: According to figures Ukraine's military intelligence (HUR) gave the Ukrainian outlet NV, published on 20 October 2026 and reported by Euromaidan Press, Russia holds up to 700 ballistic missiles and several thousand cruise missiles in reserve, roughly the same level HUR reported in July despite the autumn mass strikes.…

items.en: Bipartisan group of 23 US House members urges Trump to ask Elon Musk to let Ukraine use Starlink to hunt Russian ballistic missile launchers inside Russia

items.sEn: A bipartisan group of 23 members of the US House of Representatives, seven Republicans and 16 Democrats, has written to President Donald Trump urging him to ask Elon Musk to let Ukraine use the Starlink satellite internet system to hunt for missile launchers inside Russia. items.en: Ukraine says an intercepted Russian document plans up to 1,000 missiles, drones and bombs against 60 Ukrainian infrastructure targets this winter
items.nl: Oekraïne zegt dat een onderschept Russisch document deze winter tot 1.000 raketten, drones en bommen tegen 60 Oekraïense infrastructuurdoelen voorziet
items.sEn: Ukraine says it has obtained a Russian plan for a winter strike campaign against its critical infrastructure. items.nl: HUR: Rusland slaagde er niet in westerse chips in de Kinzjal-raket te vervangen en keerde terug naar Amerikaanse processoren

items.en: Ukraine's foreign intelligence: European NATO members may be a 'second target' of Russia's winter missile buildup
items.nl: Oekraïense buitenlandse inlichtingendienst: Europese NAVO-landen mogelijk 'tweede doelwit' van Russische winter-rakettenopbouw
items.sEn: Ukraine's Foreign Intelligence Service (SZRU) has warned that European NATO members may become a "second target" of Russia's winter missile buildup, alongside primary strikes on Ukraine's critical infrastructure and power grid.
